# Michael Risser Real Estate

> Michael Risser is an Associate Broker specializing in residential real estate across 6 Pennsylvania counties.

This website serves as a lead generation landing page detailing Michael Risser's 38+ years of experience, RE/MAX Hall of Fame status, and services for buyers and sellers. It features a contact form for inquiries, client testimonials, and a portfolio of recent closings in Chester, Delaware, Bucks, Montgomery, Lancaster, and Berks counties.
